outcome: Convergent validity between PROMIS and PODCI scores
Correlation between patient and parent outcome scores
cohort: 50 patients with brachial plexus birth injury (BPBI) recruited from a tertiary referral center.
finding: High convergent validity was found between the PROMIS and PODCI measures, with PROMIS CAT demonstrating better discriminant validity and PROMIS SF having a lower completion time, despite PROMIS CAT potentially taking longer.
cross-section timing: Data was collected at a single point in time for patients with brachial plexus birth injury, with questionnaires completed according to subject age.
